core_obligations: Record the attribution of the first asymptotic formula to the published proposition and identify what remains to be proved, namely the behaviour at the endpoint minus one (proof line 475).
Derive the representation of the Szegoe function as the square root of a quotient of branch factors times the exponential of a Cauchy type integral over the cut (proof lines 477-487).
Analyse the argument of the exponential by a residue computation that transfers the integral over the cut to the contour integral appearing in the statement (proof lines 489-497).
Control the logarithmically singular part at the endpoint and conclude the displayed uniform asymptotic behaviour with the constant written as a contour integral (proof lines 497-510).
